description.zh:
配额申请结束的UTC时间。

> `ApplyStartTime`和`ApplyEndTime`之间的时间间隔必须小于等于7天。如果未设置这两个参数，则配额申请时间为最近7天。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is in UTC.

> The interval between `ApplyStartTime` and `ApplyEndTime` must be 7 days or less. If you do not set these two parameters, quota applications submitted within the last 7 days are queried.

description.zh:
配额申请开始的UTC时间。

> `ApplyStartTime`和`ApplyEndTime`之间的时间间隔必须小于等于7天。如果未设置这两个参数，则配额申请时间为最近7天。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is in UTC.

> The interval between `ApplyStartTime` and `ApplyEndTime` must be 7 days or less. If you do not set these two parameters, quota applications submitted within the last 7 days are queried.
The ID of the batch quota application.

description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：30。
description.en:
The maximum number of results to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30.

description.zh:
用来标记开始读取数据的位置。

> 不设置该参数，表示从头开始。
description.en:
The token that marks the start of the data to read.

> If you do not set this parameter, the query starts from the beginning.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProducts](~~440555~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service.

> For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

description.zh:
配额种类。取值：
- CommonQuota：通用配额。
- FlowControl：API速率配额。
- WhiteListLabel：权益配额。
description.en:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

- CommonQuota: general quota.

- FlowControl: API rate limit.

- WhiteListLabel: privilege.

title.zh: 查询配额模板批量配额申请历史

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-for-template --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --apply-start-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --apply-end-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
